candidate.change: INT8 W8A16 (symmetric, group 128, Marlin for every row count) for the vocab-parallel lm_head shared by the target and the DFlash2 drafter

fidelity.harness: scripts/fidelity (docs/fidelity/REPORT.md method: teacher-forced prompt_logprobs, bootstrap over source groups B = 2000, seed 20260927)
fidelity.load: one measurement-mode boot of le36-m; the flag /tmp/glm53-e36-lm-head selects the path on every rank, changed only while idle and read back

runs.reference: Cnow/prompt-a (flag bf16: the current recipe's BF16 head)

fidelity.corpus: all 424 windows of the provisional manifest (global sha256 prefix 5e962c36), K = 20
fidelity.comparison: campaign.config.json pair le36-vs-cnow (floor floor-r0); bit-identity check cm-a-vs-cnow-a (non-strict, informational)

gate.metric: mean delta NLL per position (candidate minus reference), token-weighted over the finite subset, source-group bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 20260927), one-sided upper bound ub95
gate.rule: PASS when ub95 <= log1p(0.005) nats (+0.5% perplexity) in the dense regime AND the integrity check passes; otherwise FAIL. The campaign's generic KL/top-1 verdict is not the E36 gate.
gate.integrity: in the dense and all-position blocks, the candidate's nonfinite actual-token scores (infinite NLL, missing, zero probability, other) must not exceed the reference's
descriptive: all-position and sparse delta NLL with their floor (floor-r0)
gate.on_fail: no serving window; the service returns to the E35 default

fidelity.numeric_receipt: E36_LM_HEAD_W8A16_READY on every rank: group-128 weight relative L2 (row chunks), logit relative L2 and top-1 agreement of eight seeded Gaussian rows; the load refuses a non-finite result or a logit relative L2 above 5%

performance.load: one serving boot of the candidate (conversion in place, BF16 freed)
performance.protocol: upstream Rigmark c5a0db0 with the reference flags, fresh comparison ID per suite, memory guard, spec-decode counters before and after each suite
performance.comparison: the frozen E35 record (docs/historical_benchmarks/baselines/2026-09-30-e35/baseline.json), a different load: descriptive
performance.expected: code decode and C1 about +2%, time to first token unchanged or lower, C2/C4 and prefill unchanged

amendments.change: gate restricted to the dense regime (was dense and all positions); integrity check added; receipt refusal limits added
amendments.reason: an independent review and the campaign floor: identical R0 executions already reach an all-position ub95 of about +0.48% perplexity (floor-r0), because the sparse regime varies between executions, so an all-position limit of +0.5% would fail on noise; the dense regime is deterministic (floor 0) and carries the INT8 effect

amendments.change: the conversion resolves the target head with the image's get_target_lm_head(target, get_language_model()), as the DFlash sharing does
amendments.reason: the first measurement boot stopped at load: the target is a ForConditionalGeneration wrapper whose top level has no lm_head; the conversion refused it and no window was scored
